incidents.title: Digital Arrest Threat — CBI Officer Impersonation

evidence.excerpt: Caller: This is Mumbai Customs Department. A package registered in your name contains counterfeit currency and passport copies. An FIR has been regist...
Caller: Main CBI officer Rajesh Sharma bol raha hoon. Aapke Aadhaar card par illegal parcel Mumbai customs ne pakda hai. Is parcel mein drugs aur mone...

counter_evidence.observation: The incidents claim different institutions (Central Agency vs Courier Customs).
counter_evidence.explanation: One group can impersonate several institutions, but a different claimed institution makes a common origin less likely.

counter_evidence.observation: The incidents are in different languages (mixed vs en).
counter_evidence.explanation: Recorded as context only: campaigns target many languages, so this is not a contradiction.
